messages.subject: Senior Executive Candidate | Mining, Energy, ESG & Government Relations | GCC
messages.body:
Dear Recruitment Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior international opportunities across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional execution in a major mining environment.

My background also includes regulated banking and commercial account management, giving me a broad operating perspective across governance, risk, stakeholder management and business delivery. I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate assignments and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my executive CV for consideration for Director, Head, Country, External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Operations or related senior mandates.
